signatures.description: Implement a scanline polygon rasterizer for self-intersecting paths under the nonzero winding rule, with conservative coverage so that no pixel whose square intersects the filled region is omitted, and exact clipping to an integer viewport that must not flip winding at the boundary. Handle quadratic Bezier flattening within a stated tolerance, subpixel vertices, and holes formed by opposite-winding subpaths. Emit a deterministic 8-bit-per-pixel coverage mask that is invariant to direction reversal for hole-free shapes.
